h: The Double Consolation Revealed Through Shabbos Holiness

p: "for she has received from the hand of Hashem
of the Holy One, blessed is He,
to pay a person double for his sin?
הָא עַל זֶה גַּם כֵּן קָשֶׁה
for about that too it is difficult:
of the Holy One, blessed is He?
And it appears that this was difficult
for it is measure for measure,
of the Holy One, blessed is He:
"With the measure that a person measures
עַל הַדּוֹר שֶׁל חוּרְבַּן בַּיִת רִאשׁוֹן
about the generation of the destruction of the First Temple
And it appears the meaning is
And we must understand the expression
that are both a positive and a negative commandment,
"The Holy One, blessed is He, is 'Remember,'
where are the commandments of the Torah?
and all the commandments of the Torah
which allude to the Holy One, blessed is He,
The Holy One, blessed is He,
is vav, the letter of truth,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל)
(as is written in the holy Zohar on this parsha, cited above),
for the lambs correspond to Yaakov,
(Rashi, Pinchas, on the Musaf of Pesach);
and on Shabbos the two lambs
correspond to Yaakov and his sons,
for the Holy One, blessed is He, and His Shechinah,
Shabbos, which corresponds to the attribute of Malchus,
"And you shall call Shabbos a delight — oneg";
"And a river went out of Eden
"and the holy one of Hashem honored"
in the manner of what it says (Chullin 133a):
and "the Holy One, blessed is He, is called Torah"
which are in the mystery of oneg,
rectify the corruption of the serpent,
and the yetzer hara is cleared away;
and they merit "the holy one of Hashem honored,"
"so is one who gives honor to a fool"
as Torah given to an unworthy student;
and that is Torah she'b'al peh,
in which there are teacher and student.
also corresponds to the two holinesses;
it counts them against the attributes,
"To declare Your kindness in the morning
the attribute of day and the attribute of night,
the aspect of the Holy One, blessed is He,
in the manner of what is written
to the Holy One, blessed is He, and His Shechinah.
in the Midrash Rabbah cited above:
is against the Holy One, blessed is He,
is against the aspect of His Shechinah;
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב (יְשַׁעְיָה נ, א)
in the manner of what is written (Yeshayahu 50:1):
"and for your transgressions your mother was sent away";
שֶׁבְּכָל צָרָתָם לוֹ צָר (יְשַׁעְיָה סג, ט)
for "in all their affliction He is afflicted" (Yeshayahu 63:9),
the Holy One, blessed is He, and His Shechinah,
for there shines in the heart
from the Holy One, blessed is He, and His Shechinah.
And the time is on Shabbos,
which corresponds to the attribute of Malchus,
and the holy Atika and Ze'ir Anpin
that is, the whole Name Havayah,
with the tip of the yud,
